text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
――I can see it, I can feel it...!
The destination of this pulsing power!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I can feel everything!!
Not yet, not yet... not yet—!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...!!
Ah, I heard it—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A crushing victory! A landslide win for Epiphaneia!
With absolute, flawless strength where heart, technique, and physique became one!
She claims the Chrysanthemum Crown!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Oooooohhhh...!?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing her completely come to terms with her fighting spirit, running flawlessly... her sheer power sets my heart racing. My vision blurs—
choice_data_list: I can feel it— your destiny—
I can feel it— your destiny—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Who's that crying person?
Trainer? Wow, they're really overcome with emotion...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I mean... are you for real, Epiphaneia...!
That was almost completely flawless!
What happened to all that shakiness in the first two Classic races?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"No, maybe this side of her is who she truly is...
She, too... had the makings of a champion...!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: A dominant performance like that in the long-distance Kikuka Sho... Isn't she crazy strong? She might just be the best of her generation!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Epiphaneiaaa!!" "Congratulations!"
"You were crazy strong...!"
"Congrats to Trainer-san too!" "That was the best!!"

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible...! Epi-san...!
Running through that rough track with so much power...
—She dashed right past like a flash of light...!

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Incredible—my chest feels so hot...!

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Epi-san...! 
Someday, I'll—I'll become just like you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Destiny has been—bestowed...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
You're going to win "properly," aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"That's the role of the sun.
If I keep building it up, someday those 'voices' will also...!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Epiphaneia returned with a look of even greater conviction than usual.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
A victory that makes everyone's hearts race, one that everyone yearns for.
Achieving that—is what fulfilling a dream is all about.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"If we do that, everyone will feel the hand of destiny.
And then—"
choice_data_list: You can awaken the voice of destiny!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yeah! If I keep winning like I did today, that voice is bound to awaken at some point!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No, it will definitely awaken!
The voice of destiny says so too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
At the end of it all—I'll make everyone!
Every single Umamusume happy!!
choice_data_list: Ah, I know you can do it!
Yeah, I know you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To be honest, the conditions for her voice to awaken remain unclear. Even so, the path she wants to walk—the path of winning properly—is by no means wrong.
choice_data_list: (I'll figure out the conditions as we go)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer!
Back to the dance!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'll lift you up
in the winner's circle!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Epiphaneia and I bathed in
the crowd's roaring astonishment for the second time that day—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Epi-san!
It was a flawless victory...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe!
Thank you, both of you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, won't you pat my head?!
I want you to praise me more!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Huh? T-That's...
Even though you're my senior...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Never mind that, it's fine!
Come on, right now! Right this second! Do it!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Umm...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Now then...
There, there...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: …………――Well done.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!!
Thank you!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer, you're next!!
Come on, come on, come on, come on!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swept up in Epiphaneia's momentum, I instinctively
touched her head. Clumsily, but pouring
all my feelings into it—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!!!!
Congratulations to you too!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Let's keep this momentum going and rack up win after win in next year's Senior class too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"What everyone really watches is the royal road, after all!
In that case, to start things off—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Osaka Hai is the quintessential GⅠ race that decides the strongest in spring middle-distance racing. In the Senior Class, upperclassmen will be among your rivals, but—
choice_data_list: If it's you, Epi, you can handle any opponent

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, right on!
Alright, the Osaka Hai it is!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Finally, the voice of destiny shall awaken—
Our true guidance begins!!
